source: github.com/mdniprovskyi/time-machine-data (cross-references VIINA, the Kaggle 'Massive Missile Attacks on Ukraine' dataset and UCDP). Documented-minimum counts; missiles and drones are only filled where a weapon count could be attributed to that city and day.
license: Author describes the pipeline output as free for non-commercial use; confirm before any commercial use.
bearingNote: bearing is an illustrative approach direction for the tracer animation, not recorded launch data

returnFire.source: GeoConfirmed placemarks (geoconfirmed.org) as carried in github.com/mdniprovskyi/time-machine-data; Ukrainian-side (blue) placemarks located inside Russia, Belarus or occupied Crimea by point-in-polygon against Natural Earth admin-1.
returnFire.note: Each placemark is a geolocated event, not necessarily a strike: the Kursk and Belgorod border areas include ground actions. GeoConfirmed's icon code is kept per event but its legend is not public.
returnFire.license: GeoConfirmed publishes no license file for its placemark export; confirm terms before any use beyond this prototype.
